news.title: What Are U.S. Military Options in Iran?

news.title: Who Controls Ukraine’s Starlink Access?
news.summary_en: A 100 mph speed limit on Starshield terminals hindered Ukraine’s efforts to intercept Russia’s jet-powered drones. The risk of losing access during an attack gives allies another reason to build their own networks instead of buying service from U.S. companies.

news.title: Deepfakes Are Dominating Global Elections, and Regulation Is Playing Catch-Up
news.summary_en: As AI-generated deepfakes become increasingly prevalent in elections worldwide, governments are struggling to distinguish political expression from deception and enforce regulations before misleading content reaches voters.
